name: Carpentry
summary: Finish carpentry, trim, doors, framing repairs, cabinets, built-ins and custom woodwork for remodeling and repair projects.

faqs.question: Do you handle both finish carpentry and framing repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes. The scope can include visible finish work as well as framing repairs when required by the project.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim profiles?
faqs.answer: We inspect the existing profile and source or fabricate the closest practical match based on availability.
